title: keeps what is typed while the colour does not move
why: The field put back to the colour after every render: every keystroke in Hex value reverts to the swatch's colour.

title: follows a colour that moves, the refusal going with it
why: The field no longer following the colour: after a drag or a reset it shows the old hex, and the six-digit refusal stays under it.

title: is the colour the drag was released on when the last move and the release come in one task
why: The picker's own end passed straight through, as before issue 671: react-colorful reports the colour of the move before the last when the release arrives before React has rendered the last move, so the map is built one step short of the colour the swatch shows.
